description: Payment-ledger revenue for a period grouped by the paying visitor's session-entry dim: channel (default), referrer, path (entry page), country or campaign. Rows have key (raw, joinable with get_breakdown), label, revenueCents and payments. connected=false with currency null means no payment provider (not zero revenue). Optional filters: JSON array [{ "d": "country", "o": "is", "v": ["DE"] }]. Values OR within a dimension, AND across dimensions. Region uses country:region (e.g. US:CA). Read-only.

filters.description: Dashboard filters as JSON array, e.g. [{ "d": "country", "o": "is", "v": ["DE"] }]. Values within a dimension are OR'd; dimensions are AND'd. Region values are country:region (e.g. US:CA).

name: get_revenue_breakdown
title: Get revenue by source
